literal: Look yonder, my lover goes; look here, on my body pallor spreading.
translation: Look yonder, my lover is departing! Look here, pallor is already spreading over my body.
modern: அதோ பார், என் காதலர் செல்கிறார்; இதோ பார், என் உடம்பில் பசலை நிறம் படர்கிறது.
explanation: The heroine expresses her sorrow at her lover's departure by pointing out the immediate physical effect it has on her. She tells her friend to look yonder at her lover who is walking away. In the very next breath, she tells her to look here at her own body, where the pale hue of separation is already spreading. The contrast between yonder (உவக்காண்) and here (இவக்காண்) emphasizes how instantly the grief of separation manifests as physical pallor.
